body:
Just to confirm that I am now (v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]) able to move the textures to the TextureRectangle, but now the sprite frame selection does not register the clicks correctly. It behaves the same like the previous bug and also same like before the drag and dropping works as it always worked when I'm using a trackpad and works everywhere else in Godot too (and also in other programs).

What happens:
After clicking on the "grid" icon when importing frames for an AnimatedSprite2D, the first frame I touch with my pen does not get selected. If I move the pen / cursor to the next frame, the next frame gets selected and marked with "0" (and then if I continue dragging, other frames are marked too).

When I click on a frame with my touchpad, whatever I click on gets selected without any problems.

Here is what it looks like when I'm tapping a frame with my pen (as you can see it does not register):
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2d0649b4-5c74-488d-b536-a550cfd7afb1)

Here is what happens when I tap a frame with my touchpad (expected behavior):
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb5cbf72-4f07-495c-87f7-6de3d18d087a)
